backup.production_rule: Additive. One new table (staff_pay_requests: RLS on, no policy, service_role only), five new columns (cleaner_rate_schedule.transport_rate, staff_details.payout_qrph, cleaning_sessions.pay_request_id, cleaning_expense_claims.pay_request_id and receipt_path), one new cleaner_rate_schedule row (2026-09-30: 500 / 1000 / 150), a guard trigger on cleaning_sessions (pay_request_id moves only through the definer RPCs), five new functions (staff_pay_candidates_v1 and staff_pay_request_create_v1 for authenticated; telegram_staff_pay_step_v1 for service_role; staff_pay_rate_v1 and staff_pay_settle_v1 internal, no grant), one column grant (staff_details user_id + payout_qrph to service_role, which had none), and save_staff_details_v1 replaced by its live body (md5(prosrc) aff77cec89cc6b9130a6e41c0014819a, read 2026-10-05) plus the payout_qrph patch key and a masked history snapshot. Side effect by design: /payclean and the airbnb_cleans estimate use 500 for cleans from 2026-09-30. The payout QR value is NOT in this release: it is written afterwards through the dashboard or the one-off SQL. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, then fill both. Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time. Run supabase/sql/2026-10-05-d298-cleaner-pay-backfill.sql after this release and before the staff page goes live.

rollback.safe_until: the first staff pay request is paying or paid; after that, roll forward

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Redeploy the previous notify-cleaner-payment and telegram-expense first (the new telegram-expense selects pay_request_id and the poster calls the create RPC), then apply supabase/rollbacks/20261005_staff_pay_requests.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it refuses while a request is paying or paid, drops the guard trigger, the five functions, the two pay_request_id columns, receipt_path, the table, staff_details.payout_qrph (the stored QR is lost; decode it again from Drive), the 2026-09-30 schedule row and transport_rate, and restores the previous save_staff_details_v1 body. Ledger rows written by the backfill file stay (void them by logged_by = backfill D-298 if that too is reversed).

feature_flags.name: sql_then_functions
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release BEFORE deploying the new telegram-expense (bookCleaningFee selects cleaning_sessions.pay_request_id and payCleanList filters on it; both fail without the column) and notify-cleaner-payment. Then the backfill file, then the one-off payout QR SQL, then the staff pay page last.
